title: Building a ₹48 Lakh Pipeline for a Contract Pharma Manufacturer
challenge: A mid-sized contract manufacturing company wanted to expand its domestic B2B client base. Despite established facilities and a competitive offering, the leadership team had limited visibility among pharmaceutical brand owners and procurement decision-makers.
solution: Myntmore combined founder-led thought leadership with targeted prospecting. We built messaging around manufacturing reliability, quality standards, scalability and long-term contract partnerships. Outreach targeted pharmaceutical founders, sourcing heads and business development leaders.
